notes.title: The first demo update
notes.content: [h1]First demo update is LIVE - black hole issue is fixed![/h1][p][/p][p]Hello everyone! [/p][p]First and foremost, thanks for all the wonderful reactions and bug reports! It really helped us tackle the critical problems. The most common report was the black hole issue, and good news— we fixed it! Furthermore, we improved the asteroid collision and water visibility, so you don't lose track of them as easily.[/p][p][/p][p]We're really happy with how the Curiosmos demo was received, and from the bottom of my heart, thank you!! It makes us extremely excited to expand the universe.[/p][p][/p][p]Cheers & lots of love,[/p][p]Céline[/p]

notes.title: ✵ !!! We 𝐖𝐎𝐍 the WINGS Award at A MAZE. Berlin !!! ♛♕✵
notes.content:
[h3][i]The title says it all: we 𝐖𝐎𝐍 the WINGS Award at the A MAZE. Fest in Berlin!![/i][/h3][p]It comes with a lil' shiny cash prize and a beautiful TROPHY. I'm still not over it.
[/p][p]The WINGS Award is given to games where women or gender-marginalised folks lead the charge. So receiving it for Curiosmos, a game I started building from just a tiny dream and a bunch of determination into a game being made by this awesome team, means the universe to me. ✨[/p][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth="600"][tr][td colwidth="600"][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048036/6568abb758f0039b2009c29dd2a19e59c5fb9da6.jpg"][/img]
𝐶𝑒́𝑙𝑖𝑛𝑒 & 𝑡ℎ𝑒 𝑆𝑖𝑙𝑙𝑦 𝑆𝑡𝑎𝑟𝑠 𝑟𝑒𝑐𝑒𝑖𝑣𝑖𝑛𝑔 𝑡ℎ𝑒 𝑎𝑤𝑎𝑟𝑑[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][p][i]Here’s what they said during the announcement (and yes, I almost cried):[/i][/p][hr][/hr][p][i]"A sʟᴏᴡ ᴜɴғᴏʟᴅɪɴɢ. [/i]
[i]ᴏ̨ᴜɪᴇᴛ ɪɴᴠɪᴛᴀᴛɪᴏɴ. [/i]
[i]Tᴏ ғᴇᴇʟ sᴍᴀʟʟ ᴀɴᴅ ᴘᴏᴡᴇʀғᴜʟ ᴀᴛ ᴛʜᴇ sᴀᴍᴇ ᴛɪᴍᴇ. [/i][/p][p][i]A ɢᴀᴍᴇ ᴛʜᴀᴛ ʜᴀɴᴅs ʏᴏᴜ ᴛʜᴇ ᴜɴɪᴠᴇʀsᴇ. Lɪᴛᴇʀᴀʟʟʏ. [/i]
[i]A ᴘʟᴀʏғᴜʟ, ᴘᴏᴇᴛɪᴄ sᴀɴᴅʙᴏx ᴡʜᴇʀᴇ ʏᴏᴜ ʙᴜɪʟᴅ ʏᴏᴜʀ ᴏᴡɴ sᴏʟᴀʀ sʏsᴛᴇᴍ ғʀᴏᴍ sᴄʀᴀᴛᴄʜ: sᴄᴜʟᴘᴛɪɴɢ ᴘʟᴀɴᴇᴛs, ᴘᴜʟʟɪɴɢ ᴍᴏᴏɴs ɪɴᴛᴏ ᴏʀʙɪᴛ, ᴀᴅᴊᴜsᴛɪɴɢ ɢʀᴀᴠɪᴛʏ, ᴘʟᴀʏɪɴɢ ᴡɪᴛʜ ᴀᴛᴍᴏsᴘʜᴇʀᴇs, ᴀɴᴅ ᴇᴠᴇɴ sᴘᴀʀᴋɪɴɢ ʟɪғᴇ. Iᴛ’s ᴛʜᴇ ᴋɪɴᴅ ᴏғ ɢᴀᴍᴇ ᴛʜᴀᴛ ᴍᴀᴋᴇs ʏᴏᴜ ғᴇᴇʟ ᴘᴏᴡᴇʀғᴜʟ ᴀɴᴅ sᴍᴀʟʟ ᴀᴛ ᴛʜᴇ sᴀᴍᴇ ᴛɪᴍᴇ, ʟɪᴋᴇ ᴀ ᴄᴏsᴍɪᴄ ᴇɴɢɪɴᴇᴇʀ ᴡɪᴛʜ ᴀ ɢʟᴜᴇ sᴛɪᴄᴋ. [/i][/p][p][i]Iᴛ ᴡᴀs ᴍᴀᴅᴇ ʙʏ ᴀ ᴏ̨ᴜᴇᴇɴ ᴛʜᴀᴛ sʟᴀʏs. Aʟᴡᴀʏs ʜᴀs. Bᴜᴛ sɪɴᴄᴇ 2022, sʜᴇ ʜᴀsɴ’ᴛ ᴊᴜsᴛ sʟᴀʏᴇᴅ sᴏʟᴏ, sʜᴇ ɢᴀᴛʜᴇʀᴇᴅ ᴀ ᴄʀᴇᴡ ᴛᴏ ʙʀɪɴɢ ᴛʜɪs ᴄᴇʟᴇsᴛɪᴀʟ ᴠɪsɪᴏɴ ᴛᴏ ʟɪғᴇ. [/i][/p][p][i]Tʜᴇ ᴡɪɴɴᴇʀ ᴏғ ᴛʜᴇ A MAZE. WINGS Aᴡᴀʀᴅ ɪs… Cᴇʟɪɴᴇ ᴀɴᴅ ᴛʜᴇ Sɪʟʟʏ Sᴛᴀʀs ᴡɪᴛʜ Cᴜʀɪᴏsᴍᴏs!"[/i][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]The moment was incredible, I want to high-five the galaxy.[/p][p]I’m just so thankful... for the team (Robin, Guillaume, Chris, Tom, Titouan, Pepijn), for our community, for everyone who’s played the game and said something kind. For you!![/p][p]Buttttt, winning this award doesn’t mean the game is done. It just means the universe is nudging us forward.[/p][p][/p][h3][i]So what now?[/i][/h3][p]We’re still deep in development, sculpting oceans and atmospheres, tuning gravity until it feels right, and giving planets their weird little wishes.[/p][p]The game is planned to release later this year. (It’s real!! It's happening!!)[/p][p][/p][p]And I’ll have more to share soon - including our new Discord, updates from upcoming Steam events, and a whole lot more nonsense from the space corner. 🪐[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for cheering us on, whether loudly or quietly.[/p][p][/p][p]Sending you all a lot of love,[/p][p][/p][p][i]~ Slightly overwhelmed but intensely happy Céline[/i][/p]

notes.title: OH... I forgot to tell you?? Curiosmos was in Day of the Devs!! + 2025 plans ✵
notes.content:
So, um... BIG NEWS! I [i]completely[/i] forgot to update you here, oops! Curiosmos was featured in Day of the Devs: Game Awards Edition back in December, and it was [b]AMAZING[/b]. Seeing our little game up there with so many cool titles felt pretty legendary.

This showcase is ✰ extra special ✰ because it’s all about gameplay—real in-game footage with a voice-over explaining what on earth (or space??) you actually do in Curiosmos.

[url=https://youtu.be/WvxGulZT9Ig?si=4POJLfWZoMEk6Lk_&t=4070]→ Check it out here (1 hour 7 minutes in)[/url]!

I'd really recommend checking out the full showcase, as many cool games were shown last December. 

But if you want a snappy gameplay video that I edited [i]just for you[/i], then this is your link 
→ [url=https://youtu.be/3BQXxI8ktJw]Day of the Devs Gameplay Special[/url]

[previewyoutube=3BQXxI8ktJw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]What’s next in 2025? [/h2]
Yes, we are planning to release Curiosmos this year, so it will be a WILD year for sure! Here’s what we’re already working on and what’s coming up:

🌊 Oceans & liquids– the most exciting of all
🧬 Evolution!! (no humans allowed)
🙏 Planets will have wishes! You better fulfill them, or else...
💬 I’m setting up a Discord and it's almost ready, let me know if you want in!
📱 More TikToks! Here’s a little [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@celineveltman/video/7432004994213170464]LINK[/url] to the channel.
🚀 Release?!?

Many more things to do before this game is ready for the world. But by the time we finish Curiosmos, I bet the world will be ready for it.

Pfeeew we made it to the end! That’s all for now... Wishing you all a wonderful 2025, and hopefully, see you soon!

Lots of love,
~ Céline
